info.name: Salesforce QA - CRUD Operations
info.description:
Salesforce REST API collection for QA environment with CRUD operations for Accounts, Leads, and Contacts.

## Setup Instructions:
1. Import this collection into Postman
2. Create a new environment (or use the provided environment template)
3. Set the following environment variables:
   - `sf_base_url`: https://arx--qa.sandbox.my.salesforce.com
   - `sf_api_version`: v60.0
   - `sf_access_token`: Your Salesforce access token (get via OAuth or JWT)
   - `sf_instance_url`: Your Salesforce instance URL (usually same as base_url)

## Authentication:
This collection uses Bearer Token authentication. You can obtain an access token via:
- OAuth 2.0 flow (recommended for Postman)
- JWT Bearer Token flow
- Username/Password flow

## Note:
No credentials are stored in this collection. All sensitive data should be stored in Postman environment variables.

item.name: Accounts

request.description:
Creates a new Account record in Salesforce.

**Required Fields:**
- Name (string)

**Common Optional Fields:**
- Type (string)
- Industry (string)
- Phone (string)
- Website (string)
- BillingStreet, BillingCity, BillingState, BillingPostalCode, BillingCountry
- Description (string)

Retrieves an Account record by its Salesforce ID.

**Path Parameter:**
- account_id: The 18-character Salesforce ID of the Account

Retrieves an Account record with only specified fields (more efficient than getting all fields).

**Query Parameter:**
- fields: Comma-separated list of field API names to retrieve

Updates an existing Account record.

**Path Parameter:**
- account_id: The 18-character Salesforce ID of the Account to update

**Note:** Only include fields you want to update in the request body.

Deletes an Account record by its ID.

**Path Parameter:**
- account_id: The 18-character Salesforce ID of the Account to delete

**Note:** Deletion is permanent. Some records may not be deletable due to relationships or validation rules.

url.raw: {{base_url}}/services/data/{{api_version}}/query/?q=SELECT Id, Name, Type, Industry FROM Account WHERE Type = 'Customer' LIMIT 10

query.value: SELECT Id, Name, Type, Industry FROM Account WHERE Type = 'Customer' LIMIT 10

request.description:
Queries Account records using SOQL (Salesforce Object Query Language).

**Query Parameter:**
- q: SOQL query string (URL encoded)

**Example SOQL Queries:**
- `SELECT Id, Name FROM Account LIMIT 10`
- `SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Industry = 'Technology'`
- `SELECT Id, Name, (SELECT Id, Name FROM Contacts) FROM Account`

item.name: Leads

request.description:
Creates a new Lead record in Salesforce.

**Required Fields:**
- LastName (string)
- Company (string)

**Common Optional Fields:**
- FirstName (string)
- Email (string)
- Phone (string)
- Status (string) - e.g., "Open - Not Contacted", "Working - Contacted"
- LeadSource (string) - e.g., "Web", "Phone Inquiry", "Partner Referral"
- Title (string)
- Industry (string)

Retrieves a Lead record by its Salesforce ID.

**Path Parameter:**
- lead_id: The 18-character Salesforce ID of the Lead

Retrieves a Lead record with only specified fields.

**Query Parameter:**
- fields: Comma-separated list of field API names to retrieve

Updates an existing Lead record.

**Path Parameter:**
- lead_id: The 18-character Salesforce ID of the Lead to update

**Note:** Only include fields you want to update in the request body.

Deletes a Lead record by its ID.

**Path Parameter:**
- lead_id: The 18-character Salesforce ID of the Lead to delete

url.raw: {{base_url}}/services/data/{{api_version}}/query/?q=SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, Company, Email, Status FROM Lead WHERE Status = 'Open - Not Contacted' LIMIT 10

query.value: SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, Company, Email, Status FROM Lead WHERE Status = 'Open - Not Contacted' LIMIT 10

request.description:
Queries Lead records using SOQL.

**Query Parameter:**
- q: SOQL query string (URL encoded)

**Example SOQL Queries:**
- `SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, Company FROM Lead LIMIT 10`
- `SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName FROM Lead WHERE LeadSource = 'Web'`
- `SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, Company FROM Lead WHERE CreatedDate = TODAY`

- contact_id: The 18-character Salesforce ID of the Contact

**Query Parameter:**
- fields: Comma-separated list of field API names to retrieve

Updates an existing Contact record.

**Path Parameter:**
- contact_id: The 18-character Salesforce ID of the Contact to update

**Note:** Only include fields you want to update in the request body.

Deletes a Contact record by its ID.

**Path Parameter:**
- contact_id: The 18-character Salesforce ID of the Contact to delete

url.raw: {{base_url}}/services/data/{{api_version}}/query/?q=SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, Email, Phone, AccountId FROM Contact WHERE AccountId = '{{account_id}}' LIMIT 10

query.value: SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, Email, Phone, AccountId FROM Contact WHERE AccountId = '{{account_id}}' LIMIT 10

request.description:
Queries Contact records using SOQL.

**Query Parameter:**
- q: SOQL query string (URL encoded)

**Example SOQL Queries:**
- `SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, Email FROM Contact LIMIT 10`
- `SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName FROM Contact WHERE AccountId = '001XX000003DGbQ'`
- `SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, (SELECT Id, Name FROM Account) FROM Contact`

item.name: Authentication

request.description:
Obtains an access token using Username/Password OAuth flow.

**Required Environment Variables:**
- sf_client_id: Your Connected App Consumer Key
- sf_client_secret: Your Connected App Consumer Secret
- sf_username: Your Salesforce username
- sf_password: Your Salesforce password
- sf_security_token: Your Salesforce security token (appended to password)

**Response:**
Returns access_token, instance_url, and other OAuth details. Copy the access_token to your sf_access_token environment variable.

Obtains an access token using JWT Bearer Token flow.

**Required Environment Variables:**
- sf_jwt_assertion: JWT token (base64 encoded) signed with your private key

**Note:** JWT assertion must be generated separately using your private key and Connected App configuration. This is typically done programmatically.

**Response:**
Returns access_token, instance_url, and other OAuth details. Copy the access_token to your sf_access_token environment variable.
